behavior: placeBinary replaces a running executable through rename-aside on every OS, leaves no .old once removable, and restores the old file when the final rename fails
InstallSelf installs a verified dotf release at the target; a checksum mismatch, a missing entry or a staged binary that does not run leaves the target byte-identical
update reads the pin from @{u}:versions.conf and falls back to the checkout's, saying so
On dirty, ahead or diverged checkouts update installs the pin, skips the converge with the reason and keeps the drift status; offline installs nothing
On a current or fast-forwarded checkout the installed binary converges as a child; its failure is converge-failed
dotf update never runs install.sh or install.ps1, and its pin-path tests run on every OS, Windows included
